description: A full-year, GitHub-style calendar heatmap that shows a whole year of daily data at a glance. Who it's for Anyone tracking something daily: sales, support tickets, site visits, attendance, production. Teams reporting on fiscal years and ISO weeks. The problem it solves A year of daily values is unreadable as a line or column chart. Skewed data makes most days look the same colour. Streaks, peaks and unusual days are hard to spot by eye. What you get Layouts: full year or month blocks, multi-year bands, fiscal years and ISO week numbers. Readable colour: quantile scaling by default, so skewed data still shows its spread. Insights: peaks, streaks, unusual days and year-over-year comparisons in plain language. Day detail: click a day for its value, target variance and top contributor. Annotations: editors pin notes to days; they stay with the report. Rules: up to three rules with badges, colour cues and colour-blind-safe hatching. Also: small multiples, a monthly summary table, tooltips, cross-filtering, keyboard navigation, high contrast. Free Free to use. Microsoft certified, so it works with PowerPoint export, report email subscriptions and tenants that allow only certified visuals. Bind a Date and a Value to start. Runs entirely inside Power BI, with no external calls and no telemetry.
